basics.name: Dmitry Ivanov
basics.label: Senior Frontend Engineer
basics.summary: Frontend engineer focused on interactive graphics and high-performance web applications. Built scientific visualization at Plotly, fintech products at Mobeewave, Apple, and Brainfinance, and voice interfaces at ElevenLabs. Current open-source work covers interactive tools, WebGL, color, and audio. Trained in control systems and signal processing.

work.name: Independent
work.summary: Open-source graphics, audio, and WebAssembly; selected projects total 3,000+ GitHub stars.
highlights: [color-space.io](https://color-space.io): interactive atlas of 205 color spaces, each tested against a cited reference
[settings-panel](https://dy.github.io/settings-panel/): UI controls inferred from plain values
[gl-waveform](https://dy.github.io/gl-waveform/): WebGL2 waveform renderer; 60 fps pan and zoom over 172.8M samples
[audio](https://audio.js.org): audio editing in JavaScript; 300+ GitHub stars
[JZ](https://github.com/dy/jz) / [watr](https://github.com/dy/watr): JavaScript-to-WebAssembly compiler
Claude Code daily; agent changes verified by differential tests against reference implementations

work.name: Brainfinance
work.summary: Consumer fintech serving 100,000+ users in Canada: icash.ca loans and earna.zone savings.
highlights: Built the earna.zone design system and frontend on Next.js (shadcn, Tailwind, Storybook): landing, dashboard, application flows
Rebuilt icash.ca loan application and contract signing; fixed validation errors that blocked form submission
Raised key flows above 95 in PageSpeed; fixed WCAG AA accessibility issues

work.name: ElevenLabs
highlights: Launched elevenlabs.io: 11ty, Firebase auth, Stripe payments, voice API access
Built the browser player for generated speech

work.name: [Mobeewave](https://www.linkedin.com/company/mobeewave/about/) / [Apple](https://www.apple.com)

highlights: Mobeewave: Samsung POS tap-to-pay frontend (PCI DSS), shipped in Samsung Wallet; acquirer portal used by 50+ financial institutions

work.name: Plotly

[Point clustering](https://github.com/dy/point-cluster) for real-time exploration of up to 1 billion points
Visual-regression testing across 2,000+ chart configurations
Maintained [regl](https://github.com/regl-project/regl) (5,500+ GitHub stars) and 24 [gl-vis](https://github.com/gl-vis) repositories
